subject: Renewal planning: term options, capacity runway and QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Simon Parker <simon.parker@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning: term options, capacity runway and QBR scheduling

Simon —

Thanks for a productive renewal signal on last week’s call. I wanted to kick off a lightweight plan to get us to signed terms and a QBR in the next 3–4 weeks. High level asks below and a couple of attachments (renewal options + a short QBR availability poll).

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 1 (this week): confirm target term length and capacity uplift band
- Week 2: procurement/pricing review + draft amendment sent for redline
- Week 3: internal legal/board review at Acme (if needed) + final pricing
- Week 4: sign and QBR meeting (kickoff onboarding for uplift)

Term options we typically present: 12-month standard, 24-month discounted, or a 12-month with a committed capacity uplift and step-up pricing. For your use case earlier, the 30% uplift profile looks like the right starting point — we can model both a modest (30%) and an aggressive (60%) uplift so you can see unit economics.

Next steps for you: please confirm who on your procurement/legal side should be included and share any blackout dates for the next 4 weeks (I attached a poll to make scheduling simple).

I’m cc'ing Ben (CS) and Laura (Solutions) to scope the onboarding runway and any technical pre-reqs for the uplift.

Attachments: Acme_Renewal_Options_v2.pdf, QBR-Availability-Poll.xlsx

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Simon Parker <simon.parker@acme.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: term options, capacity runway and QBR scheduling

Grace —

Appreciate the clear timeline. We are interested in the 30% uplift option but procurement and our finance lead need to weigh in. Please loop in procurement@acme.com — they handle amendments. Also important: our board has a product spending review scheduled for June 29th, so any final pricing by June 24th would be ideal.

Cc'ing our procurement alias here. For scheduling, June 20–24 looks best on our side. Can you also include a simple cost delta table that shows monthly token spend for current vs +30% and +60%? That will help our FP&A.

Thanks,
Simon Parker
Head of Platform | Acme Financial
Simon.Parker@acme.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Simon Parker <simon.parker@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2028-06-08T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: term options, capacity runway and QBR scheduling

Hi Simon —

Thanks — looping procurement now. Per your ask I put together two concise views in the attached PDF: (1) 30% uplift and (2) 60% uplift with the monthly cost delta and estimated latency/cost tradeoffs under the current profile. Quick notes:

- 30% uplift: minimal onboarding, can be achieved within the existing Dedicated pool limits; monthly spend delta shown in the PDF.
- 60% uplift: requires a short capacity reservation window (we estimate 2–3 weeks prep) and a small step-up discount if committed for 12+ months.

Point people from our side:
- Grace O'Connor (you have me) — commercial lead
- Ben Carter — Customer Success lead for onboarding and runbook
- Laura Bennett — Solutions/technical contact for capacity sizing and runbook

I also populated the QBR-Availability-Poll.xlsx with proposed slots (June 20/21/23/24) and a short agenda: contract summary, uplift onboarding plan, timelines, and next steps. If June 24 is the deadline for your board materials, we should aim for a meeting no later than June 21 to capture any outstanding items.

Forwarding the PDF + poll now.

Grace

Simon — thanks for the fast replies. I set up a short 45-minute QBR/contract review for June 21 at 10:00am PT and sent a calendar invite to all. Agenda:
- 10 min: goals + current usage review (Grace)
- 15 min: uplift options & pricing delta (Grace + Laura)
- 15 min: onboarding timeline & runbook (Ben)
- 5 min: next steps / signoff path (all)

Action items (owner):
- Grace: finalize the two-slide monthly delta table and send by EOD June 10
- Laura: confirm any capacity pre-reqs and list any potential blockers by EOD June 12
- Acme procurement: share standard amendment template or redline expectations before June 17

If anything shifts on your side, flag it here and we’ll reprovision. Looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
